notes.title: April 13th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- now you can buy and sell materials in the store , to trade 10 units at once hold down the "shift" key and click on the material, hold down the "ctrl" key to sell/buy every kind of materials 
- now in the town hall in the investment menu, if you want to encrease/decrease investment amount by 10000, you can hold down the "shift" key and click the button
- now in the town hall you can see city's degree of prosperity

notes.title: April 11th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Now players can place a factory which will produce stable material output. Material type depends on city.

- Players can upgrade factories from city hall. High level of factories will increase material types and amount of output. Upgrading factories requires various resources like: money, spare parts, tools, etc. Materials could be purchased at the stores in major cities.

- Adjusted the cap number of goods at the store.

notes.title: 3.17 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue when sometimes character can block menu
- Added full screen option
- Added dialog speed control option
Please hit “Esc” key if you want to quit game in full screen mode.
Detailed information:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/486690/announcements/detail/254857153708040238
